subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should this broad multi-agent collaboration RFC remain the canonical OpenClaw core roadmap tracker, be split into narrower plugin/API/security design issues, or be closed to ClawHub/plugin scope under the current VISION.md guardrails?
rationale: The issue is concrete and has useful practitioner input, but it adds new core behavior, config, storage, memory visibility, and delegation/security policy that conflict with current lean-core and heavy-orchestration guardrails unless maintainers intentionally sponsor the direction.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Design Tracks
options.body: Keep the useful RFC context, then track capability routing, shared knowledge, memory visibility, and token governance as separate scoped items with explicit security/storage decisions.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical broad roadmap item and require all implementation PRs to reference narrower accepted sub-designs.

options.title: Move To ClawHub/Plugin Scope
options.body: Close this core issue and ask contributors to pursue the stack as plugins or ClawHub packages unless they first identify a missing core plugin API.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep the useful RFC context, then track capability routing, shared knowledge, memory visibility, and token governance as separate scoped items with explicit security/storage decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible product-scope signal in related RFC comments and adjacent agent-runtime history.
